title_sq: Dublex 3+1+Parking per shitje tek Kristal Center.

title_en: Duplex 3+1+Parking for sale in Kristal Center.
description_en: Duplex apartment 3+1 is offered for sale near Kristal Center in the Municipality of Paris. Quality construction of recent years. Thermally insulated facade.
